sentences.text: No: the May 7, 2014 circular on levy of foreclosure charges/pre-payment penalty on floating rate term loans is no longer in force on 2026-11-23 because it was withdrawn/repealed with effect from 2026-01-01.

The Reserve Bank has since issued in-force UCB directions with separate pre-payment charge rules for floating rate loans, but the applicable branch for this case cannot be confirmed from the provided facts.

missing.searched: Checked the in-force UCB directions for floating rate loans and the case facts provided; the purpose and sanction date needed to select the correct branch were not provided.
